title: pyjevsim: a Python DEVS modelling and simulation framework with HLA federate support
description: pyjevsim is a Python framework for Discrete Event System Specification (DEVS) modeling and simulation. It provides journaling, virtual- and real-time execution, and HLA federate integration through pluggable RTI backends. Version 2.3.0 runs simulations about 1.4-2.6x faster than 2.2.0 on the project's benchmark suite (CPython 3.10 to 3.14 on Windows), adds a replication runner that runs a model once per seed on a process pool, and fixes snapshot, restore and signal-handler defects. Its HLA adapters are unchanged from 2.2.0: Pitch pRTI and Portico backends with AT/SIM reference traces and application-state comparison commands, and an experimental GORTI adapter that requires a source-installed SDK and separately built service. GORTI observations are scoped functional checks, not complete HLA Object Management or formal IEEE 1516 conformance.
